item.title: Champions League: 4 teams eliminated from competition
item.description: At least four clubs have been mathematically eliminated from the Champions League. This follows the completion of Match Day 7 fixtures on Wednesday. They are: Kairat Almaty, Eintracht Frankfurt, Villarreal and Slavia Prague. Kairat Almaty, who are making their debut in the competition, have picked up just one point after knocking out Celtic. item.title: Zamfara APC crisis: Reps member, Jaji alleges exclusion from e-registration
item.description: A member of the House of Representatives representing Kaura-Namoda/Birnin Magaji Federal Constituency, Sani Jaji, has called for a fair and transparent All Progressives Congress (APC) electronic membership registration process in Zamfara State, alleging that internal party rivalries have prevented some members from registering. item.title: Lagos Computer Village fire: Affected traders appeal to Sanwo-Olu for financial support
item.description: Traders affected by the fire outbreak that razed a commercial storey building at Computer Village in Ikeja Local Government Area of Lagos State have appealed to Governor Babajide Sanwo-Olu for financial assistance to cushion the impact of their losses. item.title: Lagos tops APC nationwide e-registration as lawmaker raises exclusion allegations
item.description: Lagos State has taken the lead in the All Progressives Congress, APC, nationwide e-registration exercise, emerging as the state with the highest number of digitally registered members among the 36 states and the Federal Capital Territory. item.title: Beninoise club, USCN Cavaliers sack Usman Abdallah
